items: **A tailored resume that keeps your whole career.** Every job and career break your resume dates stays on it: older jobs, or ones with less for the post, go one line each under **Earlier experience** with what carries over, and a new **every job kept** check names any still missing. A career break is no longer counted as years worked.

**A new look for it**: a headline under your name, your LinkedIn and GitHub on the contact line, skills grouped by kind right after a summary of your whole career, and the PDF set in Source Sans 3, 10 point, with dark-blue headings, so a long career fits in two pages.

**Applications you made elsewhere**: a USAJOBS link now comes in with its whole advert (one already tracked gets it from **Fetch missing adverts**, and stays applied); a resume you sent no longer reads as cut off; one upload box, and the contact saved when you add the job.

**Delete what the AI wrote**: a tailored resume or cover letter, where it is shown. **Delete** on the Resume page deleted your uploaded resume even with a tailored one chosen; it now deletes the one chosen, and says which.
**Check still open** starts at 0% and says how many postings it checks, for how many job posts.
**Updates finish on Windows and Linux**, with a What's new list after one.
**A Microsoft Store package** (waiting on its Store listing), the Linux installers signed with GPG, and each release announced in Discussions.
